description: Approved-correct captures checked by scripts/test-desktop-qualification.py. Every listed entry becomes a hard gate failure on a matching-dimension pixel difference.

references.scene: locked sign-in card before any input
references.rationale: Re-approved for the intentional flat-compositor default introduced by 36da4931; the previous 3D-projection baseline is preserved as sign-in-1280x800-virtio-vga.3d-20261123.ppm, and the older Stage 3 capture remains as sign-in-1280x800-virtio-vga.stage3-20261123.ppm. Deterministic scene: no clock, no animation, no input-dependent state. This PPM is byte-identical across three independent 1-CPU VirtIO-GPU boots at source 36da4931 (SHA256 2713645622A311910D31F04E133F77DE0B0A2BC82C7C0EB6733AA9BAF838C6AC), captured before input; evidence: audit-artifacts/desktop-qualification-p0-signin-20261127/. Rounded card, avatar, account pills and PIN prompt remain intact. The 0.1% tolerance is unchanged. This approves the flat-path visual scene only; the full functional/timing gate still requires a serialized rerun because a concurrent `cargo test --workspace` inflated sign-in input timing in the capture run.

deferred.reason: Taskbar clock is wall-clock time, so the pixels are not deterministic across runs.
Pre-existing materially-changed-framebuffer flake; the capture is timing-sensitive and not yet a stable oracle.

deferred.capture: files-window-open.ppm, files-pointer-click.ppm, files-keyboard-refresh.ppm, settings-window-open.ppm, settings-keyboard-refresh.ppm, terminal-window-open.ppm, terminal-keyboard-input.ppm, desktop-after-window-close.ppm
